action_items: (Cosmetic) In /app/frontend/src/pages/ScoreAndLiveDetail.js:100, ensure the <option> renders raw text (e.g., {pl.full_name}) without a wrapping <span>, to silence the React hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: fantagiornata.py get_league (line 390): current_matchday_number derivation defaults to 1 when no deadlines exist AND no lineups yet — fine, but if the admin later sets a deadline for a past matchday, the endpoint will report that past matchday as 'current' (past_dl branch). Should probably prefer the earliest FUTURE deadline unconditionally, and only fall through to past if the past was VERY recent (settle window).

fantagiornata.py save_lineup applies the GLOBAL cross-game deadline (matchday_deadlines) via _global_deadline_passed — this couples FG to whatever deadline the admin set for the same matchday in another game. If a QA admin PUTs /deadlines/38 to a past timestamp for survival, FG lineup for md=38 will suddenly 403. Consider a per-game deadline or documenting this coupling.

auth.py reset-password endpoint has no minimum-length policy on new_password (client sends 'x' → 200). Recommend Pydantic min_length=8 on ResetPlayerPasswordIn.new_password to mirror registration policy.

fantagiornata.py leaderboard returns a DICT shape {league_id, leaderboard:[...]} while list_leagues + participants return raw arrays. Inconsistent — front-end may need to normalize. Documented in the test.
